content:
Apple TV currently boasts a strong lineup of shows, with flagship series including 《Slow Horses》、《Ted Lasso》、《Dark Matter》, as well as the new comedy 《Brothers》 starring Ben Affleck. However, there are even more shows coming soon. Below is Apple TV's complete premiere schedule for October.

The Last First: Winter K2

  • Date: October 2
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Documentary

Directed by Amir Bar-Lev, 《The Last First: Winter K2》 tells a complex, thrilling and moving story that examines the extreme mountaineering industry and the evolution of its culture. The story focuses on a 2021 expedition featuring Icelandic mountaineer John Snorri Sigurjónsson and the Pakistani father-and-son duo Ali and Sajid Sadpara, with the goal of becoming the first team to summit K2 in winter — the most brutal season on the mountain. During this dangerous climb, they encounter social media-driven influencer climbers and their film crews, commercial expedition clients, and renowned Nepalese mountaineer Nims and his team of Sherpas. 《The Last First: Winter K2》 takes viewers up to K2's frozen peaks, where they face unpredictable weather, and reveals an unexpected, layered story — about strategy and determination, class and hierarchy, money and power — all unfolding in a life-or-death environment.

《格林姊妹》(Season 2)

  • Date: October 2
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Kids & Family

Two orphaned sisters navigate a town filled with fairy tale and fantasy characters, encountering all kinds of heroes and villains while investigating the mystery of their missing parents. 《格林姊妹》 blends elements of exploration, fantasy and adventure, offering important lessons for viewers of all ages.

Small Prophets

  • Date: October 7
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Comedy

《Small Prophets》 is a comedy about the eccentric Michael Sleep (played by Pearce Quigley). Since his beloved Clea disappeared seven years ago, he has been living a quiet life — working at a hardware store, visiting his father Brian (played by Sir Michael Palin), and hoping for Clea's return. One day, Brian shares an ancient recipe concocted with rainwater, horse manure and a touch of alchemy. Though skeptical, Michael picks up the recipe and attempts to create an artificial homunculus — a magical creature capable of predicting the future — hoping to find the answer he most wants to know: "Will I ever see Clea again?"

Matchbox (Film)

  • Date: October 9
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Action

Adapted from the classic Mattel toy, the film version of 《Matchbox》 is an action-packed, globe-trotting adventure about a group of friends who have known each other since childhood. Their lives are turned upside down when CIA agent Sean (played by John Cena) — their former leader who disappeared years ago — returns, unexpectedly pulling them into a thrilling, world-saving international chase.

Tenzing

  • Date: October 16
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Drama

Based on a true story, 《Tenzing》 tells a little-known story centered on Tenzing Norgay (played by Genden Phuntsok). He was a gifted Himalayan mountaineer who, alongside New Zealand climber Edmund Hillary (played by Tom Hiddleston), became one of the first people to summit Mount Everest. Encouraged by his wife Dawa (played by Thinley Lhamo) and supported by expedition secretary Jill Henderson (played by Caitríona Balfe), Tenzing successfully persuaded Colonel John Hunt (played by Willem Dafoe) to let him join the British expedition as a team member rather than just a porter. While Western climbers viewed "Everest" as a conquest, Tenzing revered the sacred mountain as "Chomolungma," seeing it as the Mother Goddess. During the climb, conflicts stemming from differences in background, class and ambition proved as intense as the dangers on the mountain. But at the top of the world, empire, status and ambition all fade away, leaving two outsiders bound by mutual respect and trust — for Tenzing, it was the fulfillment of a lifelong dream and a spiritual calling.

《Where's Wanda?》(Season 2)

  • Date: October 21
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Dark Comedy

Apple's first German-language series, 《Where's Wanda?》 is a dark comedy about parents Dodo and Carlotta Klatt desperately searching for their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda. Wanda disappeared without a trace months ago, and with the police making no progress, the family decides to take matters into their own hands. With the help of their tech-savvy son Ole, they acquire surveillance equipment, disguise themselves as utility company workers, and install listening devices throughout the neighborhood and half the block, only to discover that the neighbors are far from what they appear on the surface.

Nocturne

  • Date: October 30
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Crime Drama

The series follows Jonah Lynn (played by Liev Schreiber), a veteran turned murder detective who, weary of Philadelphia's blood-soaked streets, moves to a small town in western Pennsylvania hoping for a quieter life. But when the town and his family are threatened by the cunning serial killer Jurek Walter (played by Graham), Jonah must protect everything he holds dear. When the large-scale search for Jurek's final missing victim stalls, Jonah has no choice but to send in his goddaughter — FBI agent Saga Bauer (played by Beetz) — to face Jurek personally. How much is he willing to sacrifice?

New Episodes: 《Slow Horses》、 《Brothers》 and More

Apple TV will also release new episodes in October, including the following currently airing series:

  • 《Ted Lasso》: The comedy starring Jason Sudeikis will continue releasing new episodes through October 7
  • 《Last Seen》: This crime suspense series will continue releasing new episodes through October 7
  • 《Slow Horses》: This acclaimed British spy series will continue releasing new episodes through October 21
  • 《Dark Matter》: The sci-fi series starring Joel Edgerton will continue releasing new episodes through October 30
  • 《Brothers》: The comedy starring Ben Affleck and Woody Harrelson will continue releasing new episodes through November 4

Which of Apple TV's October premieres are you planning to watch? Let us know in the comments section.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, and you can also subscribe through the Apple One bundle.
